module mg_00448(nrst, clk, din, level_sel, level_mask, edge_sel, edge_mask, trig_out);
input nrst; 
  input clk; 
  input [7:0] din; 
  input [7:0] level_sel; 
  input [7:0] level_mask; 
  input [2:0] edge_sel; 
  input edge_mask; 
  output trig_out; 
  reg d_last; 
  wire d_sel; 
  wire d_edge; 
  wire m_edge; 
  wire [7:0] d_level; 
  wire [7:0] m_level; 
  wire s_level; 
  assign d_sel = din[edge_sel]; 
  always @(posedge clk or negedge nrst) begin 
  if (~nrst) begin 
  d_last <= 1'b0; 
  end else begin 
  d_last <= d_sel; 
  end 
  end 
  assign d_edge = d_last ^ d_sel; 
  assign m_edge = d_edge | edge_mask; 
  assign d_level = ~(din ^ level_sel); 
  assign m_level = d_level | level_mask; 
  assign trig_out = &m_level & m_edge; 
 endmodule
